# Copilot Instructions

- Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for repository conventions and scope control before changing code.
- GitHub Issues in `no1ross/Kaleido` are the system of record for work and decisions. Record newly discovered work in linked Issues, and use sub-issues for genuine prerequisites.
- Every change needs an Issue and a corresponding PR. Reference resolved Issues in new commits and PR bodies using `Fixes #N`.
- Put new substantive documentation under `/docs`; README and AGENTS files remain project entrypoints. Preserve existing architecture and PriorAuth handoff guides at their current locations until separately scoped.
